All tests pass (6/6, including the pre-existing length test).

**Implementation:** Added `units/pressure.py` with `to_pascal(value, unit)` supporting `Pa`, `kPa`, `bar`, `atm` (101325 Pa exactly for standard atmosphere), raising `ValueError` on unknown units — mirroring the existing `units/length.py` pattern for consistency. Added `tests/test_pressure.py` covering all four units plus the unknown-unit error.

**Evidence:** `python3 -m unittest discover` run directly, real code path, no doubles involved — full suite green, no regressions in `test_length.py`.

No deviations from the workplan; no upstream challenge needed.
